answer: Forge each agent identity the hard way: burn 1,000 POA and solve a six-hour verifiable compute puzzle, then stamp the result into the basalt ledger alongside a unique sonnet the agent composed and signed. Peers re-challenge identities at random, demanding the sonnet's hash within 60 seconds; a miss slashes the bond and erases the entry. No appeal, no refund, no second stamp. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 10,000,000 POA plus 60,000 GPU-hours worth about $720,000, and needs 60,000 hours of puzzle time. Like a blacksmith's anvil, the forge only rewards work already done. - Jowy
